a: A particle of emphasis and of the accusative, conveying emphasis of the content of the sentence.
The male and the female of the children of Adam.
‘Fi’: a preposition conveying the meaning of figurative containment.
A particle of exception; the exception here is connected (the excepted belongs to the named group).
A relative noun for a group of males.
They acknowledged the oneness of Allah and the truthfulness of His messengers, and submitted to Allah with obedience and to the Messenger with following.
To hold fast to the firm, correct creed.
Sabr: endurance and bearing well — in avoiding sins, in doing acts of obedience, and in affliction.
